content:
Maya (CS): Quick sync 800: planning 'Renewal Ramp Labs' for next month — 2-week run, Tue/Wed blocks, 90min each. Goal: close onboarding gaps for upcoming renewals, hand off runbooks, surface renewal blockers. Need volunteers for facilitation and SRE coverage.
Omar (CS): I can take EMEA slots (prefer late-morning CET). Will pair with a Solutions engineer.
Rhea (Solutions): Happy to do a Dedicated/Private cluster clinic. Request: customers provide a minimal config dump ahead of session. I can prepare a 1-page checklist.
Chris (PM): I'll share the renewal roster (with health flags) in the drive and tag top-20 "at-risk" accounts for day-1 slots. Link incoming.
Maya (CS): Setting up a Doodle/poll now  please indicate all slots you can cover. We'll prioritize low-health accounts in the first week and leave space for follow-ups in week 2.
calendar-bot: Poll created: https://polls.redwood/renewal-ramp-4512 (expires in 72h) :spiral_calendar:
Evan (SRE): I can cover on-call for any infra deep-dive during hands-on lab. Prefer Tue/Thu cadence. CC me on invites.
Omar (CS): Suggest format: 10min intros, 20min checklist triage, 40min guided migration lab, 15min perf tuning, 5min next steps. Keep sessions to 90min max.
Rhea (Solutions): Prework ask: small smoke test + paste latency numbers into the form. I'll draft a curl snippet.
Maya (CS): Draft prework (paste into invites):
```
# prework smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello","max_tokens":16}' | jq '.latency_ms, .usage'
```
Chris (PM): I'll export tiers and share CSV by EOD. Plan: seed invites after poll closes so people get calendar holds.
Omar (CS): Also recommend inviting a recording and notes taker so we can attach post-session actions to the account. I can take notes for two slots.
Rhea (Solutions): I'll attach a short feedback form (NPS + 2 free text q's) to closing email.
Maya (CS): Great. Once poll wraps I'll post final schedule and facilitator assignments. If anyone's availability changes, update the poll. :white_check_mark:
